start: A new member with no routines, on the Workout tab showing the card 'Make your first routine'

user_sees: Step 1 'Name your folder' with the hint 'A folder keeps your routines together, like a plan for your week.'
The name box filled with 'My plan'
must_not: An empty name box with Next enabled

steps.action: Tap Next, then tap the ready name 'Push Day'
user_sees: Step 2 'Name your routine', hint 'A routine is the list of exercises for one day. Tap a name or type your own.'
must_not: Next enabled with an empty routine name
The same exercise added twice by tapping it twice (a second tap un-picks it)

user_sees: Step 4 'Check and save': 'Push Day' with each exercise and '3 sets'
Back on the Workout tab with the 'My plan' folder open and the routine in it
must_not: The folder followed as a plan the member never asked for

start: A new member at step 2 of the guide who types a name instead of tapping one

steps.action: Type 'Leg day monday' and go on to save
user_sees: The routine saved as 'Leg day monday'
Its day read from the typed name
must_not: The day of an earlier tapped name kept after typing

start: A new member at step 3 of the guide with no exercise picked

must_not: A routine saved with no exercises

steps.action: Pick 2 exercises, go to step 4 and tap 'Save routine' when the save fails
user_sees: A message that the routine could not be saved; the button can be pressed again
must_not: An empty 'My plan' folder left behind

start: A new member at step 3 with 2 exercises picked

user_sees: 'Your routine is not saved yet. You can still make one any time with New routine.'
The Workout tab without the guide card
must_not: The guide card shown again on the next visit

start: A member who makes the first routine while signed in to a gym

steps.action: Save the routine in the guide
user_sees: The routine is on this phone and in the member's own list only
must_not: The routine shown to the gym or to other members without the member sharing it
